name: Hyprland (windows, workspaces, input)

1.how: hyprctl -j clients|activewindow|workspaces|monitors|devices; hyprctl dispatch focuswindow address:<a> | movetoworkspace <ws> | togglefloating | fullscreen | exec <cmd> | killactive; hyprctl setprop address:<a> activebordercolor rgb(..); hyprctl keyword <option> <value>; event stream on $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr/$SIG/.socket2.sock
1.notes: Complete window management as JSON. The transport behind maus win *.

1.how: Wayland: virtual-keyboard-unstable-v1 and wlr-virtual-pointer (wtype, ydotool), wlr-screencopy / hyprland-toplevel-export (grim, per-window capture), wlr-foreign-toplevel, wlr-layer-shell
1.notes: Input injection and capture are compositor-level; MausOS uses them at rung 4/5 only.

2.how: ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf and files it sources (Omarchy: bindings.conf, monitors.conf, input.conf, looknfeel.conf; MausOS: mausos.conf). `hyprctl reload` applies; `hyprctl configerrors` validates.
2.notes: Window-rule syntax changed in 0.53; check `hyprctl version` before writing rules.

quirks: Super+Shift+Escape (bound in mausos.conf) runs maus agent stop --all regardless of the shell's state.
